summary: Rewriter's -remove-unused-globals drops a static global whose value is still referenced from a kept global's own initializer (a compound expression VarReferenceVisitor does not walk into), producing rewritten HLSL that fails to recompile. Confirmed on main-debug (89e2f98e2) and all 19 probeable stable releases; v1.4.1907 cannot run the flag at all.
